nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Address of the bankroll account, used by onlyBankroll/onlyOwnerOrBankroll and as destination of divertDividendsToBankroll.
Counter of total spins performed; incremented in _spinTokens without overflow protection.
Total amount of ZTH tokens wagered; incremented by _wagered during _spinTokens.
Accounting of ZTH tokens held by the contract, updated in tokenFallback and _finishSpin.
Public boolean flag controlling whether betting is allowed; toggled by pauseGame/resumeGame.
Address of the legitimate ZTH token contract, checked by _zthToken.
Bankroll address supplied at construction time.
ZTHInterface instance used for outbound token transfers and approvals.
Mapping of allowed wager amounts; initialized in constructor and extended by addNewBetAmount.
Public mapping address => playerSpin storing each player's pending wager and block number.
Zlots constructor: sets owner, bankroll, token addresses, grants infinite token approvals and enables the game.
Payable fallback function that accepts plain ether transfers without logic.
ERC223-style callback; credits contractBalance for bankroll deposits or forwards an incoming wager to _spinTokens.
Private wager entry point validating caller, bet size and jackpot guard, then recording the spin and settling any previous spin.
Public wrapper allowing msg.sender to settle their own pending spin via _finishSpin.
Private settlement routine: computes a pseudo-random result, pays winners via ZTHTKN.transfer and resets playerSpins.
View helper verifying 500x max profit does not exceed 90% of the contract balance.
View randomness helper combining address(this), blockhash(blockn) and an entropy address.
Internal helper reducing maxRandom output modulo an upper bound.
Public view returning the internal contractBalance accounting variable.
Owner-only function enabling an additional valid wager amount.
Owner-only function disabling betting by setting gameActive to false.
Owner-only function re-enabling betting by setting gameActive to true.
Owner-only function transferring contract ownership.
Owner-only function replacing the bankroll address.
Owner-only function forwarding the contract's ether balance to the bankroll address.
Private view verifying that a caller address equals the registered ZTH token address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, access control, spin targets and token source validation.
Block-level miner-influenceable value representing the block context used for result entropy.
Outbound ZTHTKN.transfer(target, profit) executed inside _finishSpin before playerSpins is reset (unsafe external call / reentrancy vector).
Result generation based on blockhash(blockn) and block.number in maxRandom/random, exploitable by miners or by players choosing the settling block.
Constructor grants unlimited (2**256-1) token allowance to bankroll and owner.
Constructor parameter for the ZTH token contract address.
Constructor parameter for the bankroll address.
Token sender address supplied to tokenFallback.
Token amount supplied to tokenFallback.
Unused token payload supplied to tokenFallback.
Memory struct TKN carrying sender and value into _spinTokens.
Address whose pending spin is being settled in _finishSpin.
Wager amount evaluated by jackpotGuard.
Block number used for blockhash entropy in maxRandom.
Entropy address mixed into maxRandom.
Modulo upper bound for random.
Block number forwarded to maxRandom from random.
Entropy address forwarded to maxRandom from random.
New allowed wager amount registered by addNewBetAmount.
New owner address passed to changeOwner.
New bankroll address passed to changeBankroll.
Local copy of _tkn.sender used for event emission in _spinTokens.
Local copy of _tkn.value used for accounting in _spinTokens.
Memory playerSpin loaded and re-stored in _spinTokens.
Memory playerSpin loaded from playerSpins in _finishSpin.
Payout amount computed by the multiplier cascade in _finishSpin.
Winning category index set in _finishSpin.
Pseudo-random result (or 999999 default) driving the payout branch logic.
500x potential profit computed in jackpotGuard.
90% of the contract balance computed in jackpotGuard.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Constructor parameter ZethrAddress is stored in ZTHTKNADDR.
Constructor parameter BankrollAddress is stored in ZTHBANKROLL.
Bankroll state variable is derived from the constructor-supplied BankrollAddress.
Constructor sets gameActive to true at deployment.
Constructor initializes the validTokenBet allow-list.
Constructor instantiates the ZTHInterface token handle.
Constructor triggers unlimited token approvals to bankroll and owner.
tokenFallback consumes the _from token sender parameter.
tokenFallback consumes the _value token amount parameter.
tokenFallback credits contractBalance with _value for bankroll deposits.
tokenFallback forwards non-bankroll tokens into _spinTokens which may settle a prior spin.
The TKN struct parameter supplies sender and value to _spinTokens.
_customerAddress is copied from _tkn.sender.
_wagered is copied from _tkn.value.
_spinTokens validates msg.sender through _zthToken before accepting a wager.
_spinTokens requires _tkn.value to be a valid token bet.
_spinTokens increments totalSpins without overflow checking.
_spinTokens adds _wagered to totalZTHWagered without overflow checking.
_spinTokens loads the caller's playerSpin struct into memory.
_spinTokens writes the updated playerSpin back into the playerSpins mapping.
_spinTokens calls jackpotGuard to constrain maximum payout.
_spinTokens calls _finishSpin to settle an existing pending spin.
_spinTokens relies on _zthToken to authenticate the token caller.
finishSpin uses msg.sender as the target address to settle.
Public finishSpin delegates settlement to private _finishSpin.
_finishSpin settles the spin of the target address parameter.
_finishSpin loads playerSpins[target] into a memory struct.
_finishSpin rewrites playerSpins[target] to zeroed defaults after payout.
_finishSpin derives the game result from the random helper.
The result variable is produced by the randomness path inside _finishSpin.
_finishSpin computes profit through a cascade of unchecked multiplier arithmetic.
_finishSpin adds losing wagers to and subtracts winnings from contractBalance.
_finishSpin performs an external token transfer while settlement state is still live.
The outbound token transfer can reenter _finishSpin before the spin record is cleared.
playerSpins[target] is reset only after the external transfer, enabling repeated settlement.
random() delegates entropy generation to maxRandom().
upper bound parameter feeds the modulo in random().
blockn parameter is forwarded from random() to maxRandom().
entropy parameter is forwarded from random() to maxRandom().
maxRandom mixes the supplied block number into the keccak256 hash.
maxRandom mixes the entropy address into the keccak256 hash.
maxRandom produces result entropy from blockhash(blockn), which is miner/player influenceable.
The pseudo-random outcome depends on block-level context that is not truly random.
Spin settlement indirectly reaches maxRandom via random(..., spin.blockn, target).
jackpotGuard evaluates the _wager parameter.
jackpotGuard reads contractBalance to cap the maximum payout.
jackpotGuard computes maxProfit = _wager * 500.
jackpotGuard computes 90% of the contract balance.
balanceOf returns the internal contractBalance accounting value.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in addNewBetAmount.
addNewBetAmount registers _tokenAmount in validTokenBet.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in pauseGame.
pauseGame sets gameActive to false.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in resumeGame.
resumeGame sets gameActive to true.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in changeOwner.
changeOwner overwrites the owner state variable with _newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in changeBankroll.
changeBankroll overwrites the bankroll state variable with _newBankroll.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in divertDividendsToBankroll.
divertDividendsToBankroll reads the bankroll address as the ether recipient.
_zthToken compares the supplied address against ZTHTKNADDR.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument only feeds initialization of ZTHTKNADDR/ZTHTKN and can be folded into the constructor core node.
Constructor argument only feeds initialization of ZTHBANKROLL and the bankroll state variable.
Incoming token sender value is only consumed inside tokenFallback before being forwarded to _spinTokens.
Incoming token amount is only used to update contractBalance or build the TKN struct for _spinTokens.
Unused token payload parameter exists only in the tokenFallback signature.
The TKN memory struct only carries sender/value into the _spinTokens core logic.
Target address parameter identifies which playerSpins entry _finishSpin settles.
Wager argument is only used to compute the 500x payout ceiling inside jackpotGuard.
Block number argument is only hashed as entropy inside maxRandom.
Entropy address argument is only hashed inside maxRandom.
Upper bound argument only acts as the modulo operand in random.
Block number argument is only forwarded from random to maxRandom.
Entropy argument is only forwarded from random to maxRandom.
Only used as the mapping key written into validTokenBet by the owner-only function.
Only used as the replacement value for the owner state variable.
Only used as the replacement value for the bankroll state variable.
Local alias of _tkn.sender used solely for the TokensWagered event emission.
Local alias of _tkn.value used solely for spin bookkeeping inside _spinTokens.
Transient memory copy of the caller's playerSpin read and written within _spinTokens.
Transient memory copy of the settled playerSpin used only inside _finishSpin.
Computed profit is the amount passed to the outbound token transfer unsafe operation.
Category index only selects the payout event and multiplier branch within _finishSpin.
Result value is produced by the blockhash-based randomness path and drives all payout branching.
Temporary 500x profit bound used only in the jackpotGuard comparison.
Temporary 90% contract balance value used only in the jackpotGuard comparison.
